## Summary

A concise description of what you want to happen.

## Problem it solves

Describe the problem or limitation this feature addresses. What use case does it enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you'd like it to work. Include API shape, UI mockups, or data model changes if applicable.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about, and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, or other relevant information.
